scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:files
scripts.format:backend: php84 backend/vendor/bin/pint backend/app backend/bootstrap/app.php backend/bootstrap/providers.php backend/config backend/database backend/routes backend/tests backend/resources backend/public backend/artisan
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && php84 backend/vendor/bin/pint --test backend/app backend/bootstrap/app.php backend/bootstrap/providers.php backend/config backend/database backend/routes backend/tests backend/resources backend/public backend/artisan
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend,scheduler "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:scheduler"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
